items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I like Phil Wood’s idea of playing acoustic.

ctx.x: Or they have their own concept of what they think you sound like.

That’s right. And they don’t know, you know, they really don’t. And then when it gets messed up then they start, you know, or if they get excited by the music they start changing. And they want to take all control. If you want to play soft, they’ll turn you up. You want to play loud, oh, that’s too loud, they turn you down. What the hell is that. Well that’s really I like Phil Wood’s idea of playing acoustic. Then you don’t have to bother with that. But that’s what happens.
Well I’m going to say thanks to Frank Wess on behalf of the Hamilton Jazz Archive. And I appreciate your thoughts with us today.
